# 136 T-AXU-044 分步骤示范图制作记录

制作日期：2026-10-14。依据：E:/git冲突问题/rehab image/动作分步骤示范图制作清单_v1.0.md，第136项高位/地面平板支撑交替抬腿。首轮选定固定高台版，共3张独立原始照片，不包含地面手掌或前臂扩展版本。

制作方式：built-in image_gen。三张均为1536 × 1024 PNG，未使用CLI/API fallback、拼图或Python图像编辑。首次文件不存在，保存时未覆盖已有图。默认生成源文件保留于CODEX_HOME生成目录，成品复制到train/steps。s02及s03均使用已检查s01作为构图/人物/台面锚点。

## 基准与侧别

人物、白色短袖T恤、深灰长裤、黑马尾、肤色和灰蓝棚拍背景以step-image-references/reference-01.png至03.png为参考；已先用view_image检查全部参考。动作姿势按清单136，不使用参考的抬臂姿势。

实际照片面向画面右，镜头略在身体前侧；近镜头、较大且画面较低的鞋属于解剖学右腿，远镜头、较小且画面较高的鞋属于解剖学左腿。审核根据画面实际侧别执行，不能只据prompt标签判断。

s01初始生成prompt曾把近侧写成LEFT，属于镜头侧别文字误写；s01要求双脚落地，其动作姿态不受该误写影响。最终s02/s03已在prompt与实际照片中明确近右/远左并逐图核对。

## 原始生成提示词

### s01实际提交prompt

```text
Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: one independent raw rehabilitation exercise demonstration photograph, not a collage.
Primary request: create action 136 T-AXU-044 step s01, the starting position for a HIGH FIXED COUNTERTOP SUPPORTED INCLINE PLANK with alternating small leg lifts.
Input images: all three supplied photographs are identity, clothing, skin tone, ponytail, photography and gray-blue backdrop references only. Their arm pose is NOT a pose reference.
Subject: precisely the same adult East Asian woman as references: natural face, black ponytail, plain white short-sleeve T-shirt, dark charcoal full-length athletic trousers. Complete hands and feet visible. Plain low-profile white athletic shoes.
Scene: gray-blue seamless studio background and floor, soft professional lighting and natural floor shadows. One sturdy fixed high rectangular worktop about waist height, pale light-gray top and substantial charcoal metal legs with stable crossbar, no wheels. It is on the right side of the woman. No other props.
Pose: woman faces screen right, slightly angled toward camera so her anatomical LEFT side is nearer camera and her RIGHT side is farther. BOTH palms flat on the fixed countertop shoulder-width apart; show each separate palm and wrist resting on top, fingers natural. Arms long and nearly straight without locked elbows. Both feet planted on the floor shoulder-width apart behind her, toes toward the table, with BOTH shoes and ground contacts separately visible. Body forms a gentle controlled diagonal line from shoulders through hips to ankles, about 45 degrees above floor, head and neck neutral. Abdomen stable, natural neutral spine, no sagging low back and no high-arching buttocks.
Composition: landscape photograph, desired 1536 x 1024 pixels. Full body, whole countertop support and both feet entirely inside frame with modest margin. Camera fixed approximately side-on but 15 degrees from the woman's front, lens normal perspective, same scale suitable for a three-image sequence. Woman occupies left-center, counter right. Show both legs distinctly with near left shoe slightly lower in the image and far right shoe slightly higher to reflect depth, NOT a stepping stance.
Constraints: anatomically correct continuous joints and proportionate head, arms, forearms, thighs and shins; exactly two arms, two legs, two hands and two shoes. Each foot fully grounded for this start frame. Keep familiar reference identity. No text, numbers, logos, arrows, diagrams, watermark or panel layout.
```

### s02最终实际提交prompt

```text
Use case: scientific-educational. Make one independent raw photorealistic rehabilitation demonstration photograph for 136 T-AXU-044 s02.
Image 1 is the approved first step and reference for everything: preserve this same East Asian woman, identity, black ponytail, white T-shirt, charcoal long trousers, white shoes, fixed gray high table with charcoal frame, gray-blue studio backdrop and floor, soft light, full-body landscape composition, exact camera angle and scale. No mirroring.
The woman faces screen right and her anatomical RIGHT side is closest to camera. Her near anatomical RIGHT leg is the one with the larger lower-left shoe. Her far anatomical LEFT leg ends in the smaller farther shoe.
Keep both palms in their original table contact points and keep the near RIGHT leg and larger near RIGHT shoe planted in their exact original floor location. Lift ONLY the far LEFT leg, extending it slightly backward toward screen left. The far LEFT shoe must be clearly visible about 8 to 12 cm above floor, behind and slightly above the right planted shoe. Do not lift the right foot. Two distinct leg outlines with natural perspective, not merged trousers.
Torso position, pelvis orientation and neutral spinal line remain unchanged. Small low controlled leg extension, no back arch, no high leg kick, no hip rotation. Complete head, both hands, both feet and full support table in frame. Single pose only; no text, arrows, numbers, panels or watermark. Desired landscape 1536 x 1024.
```

### s03最终实际提交prompt

```text
Use case: scientific-educational. Make one independent raw photorealistic rehabilitation demonstration photograph for 136 T-AXU-044 s03.
Image 1 is the approved first step, the composition and identity anchor. Preserve exactly this same woman, black ponytail, face, white T-shirt, charcoal full-length trousers, plain white athletic shoes, fixed gray high tabletop and charcoal stable frame, gray-blue studio floor and backdrop, soft light and natural shadows, exact full-body landscape camera framing, angle, perspective and scale. No mirroring. Desired 1536 x 1024.
The woman faces screen right with her anatomical RIGHT side closest to camera. Her near anatomical RIGHT leg is the one ending in the larger shoe at lower left in image 1. Her far anatomical LEFT leg ends in the smaller, farther shoe.
Start from the both-feet-down position in image 1. Keep the far LEFT leg and its smaller far LEFT shoe planted in their ORIGINAL floor position and supporting the body. Keep both palms in their original separate table contact positions. Move ONLY the near anatomical RIGHT leg slightly backward toward screen left and lift its RIGHT shoe about 8 to 12 cm above the floor. The near RIGHT foot has a clear small gap below it, and is farther back than the planted far LEFT shoe. The near right leg is naturally near straight with only a small controlled hip extension. Exactly one foot raised, exactly one foot grounded; clearly separate both legs and both complete shoes.
Torso position, shoulders and pelvis stay facing the same direction; neutral spine and controlled straight incline body line. No hip rotation, no buttock hiking, no low-back arch, no high kick. Full head, both hands, BOTH feet and entire fixed table in frame. Single pose only; no text, arrows, numbers, panels, logos or watermark.
```

## 中断与限制

一次s02早期built-in调用长时间没有返回，未提供结果或保存路径，停止了挂起exec后以same built-in重新调用；没有把未返回结果登记为成品，没有切换CLI。最终s02/s03正常返回并检查。

清单播放顺序：s01 → s02 → 复用s01 → s03 → 复用s01。s03由s01独立生成，教学排版应明确两侧之间先恢复双足落地，不把s02→s03直接并列成腾空换脚。

Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: single standalone rehabilitation demonstration photograph, T-AXU-017 step 01, LEFT side lying modified side plank PREPARATION with pelvis still on mat.

Both knees are clearly FLEXED about 90 degrees, stacked with left knee underneath on the mat and right knee above it. Thighs lie toward the left, and both shins are folded backward toward the rear edge of the mat, feet pulled back near the hip level rather than extending in a straight line past the knees. Both feet entirely visible. This is the SHORT LEVER knees-bent version. Pelvis remains low in contact with mat, torso propped comfortably on the lower left forearm, shoulders stacked over each other. Natural head neck alignment and relaxed expression.
Camera: from the FRONT of her chest, slightly oblique, low waist-height natural 50mm perspective showing the front of her torso, both bent knee joints and the left elbow/left hip contact. Full body, horizontal 3:2 landscape, head at right, feet toward left, adequate margins around all limbs and whole mat.
Constraints: anatomically left side on mat (head right), two arms two legs with realistic lengths, no joint disconnection, five natural fingers, no extra limbs; not straight-leg side plank, do not lift pelvis. One photograph only; no labels, numbers, text, arrows, watermark, panels or collage.

Change only the exercise phase: she presses into the LOWER LEFT FOREARM and LOWER LEFT KNEE and lifts her pelvis off the mat to a controlled knees-bent side bridge. Left elbow stays below left shoulder and left forearm fully touches mat. The lower left knee remains on the mat as the distal main support. Shoulder, hip/pelvis and lower left knee now lie on ONE straight diagonal line without hip sagging. Clearly visible natural air gap and shadow under the left hip/pelvis; the pelvis is raised, not resting on mat. Both knees remain bent in the short-lever version, the shins folded backwards and feet relaxed, right knee stacked on left knee. Her RIGHT palm remains lightly planted on the mat in front of the abdomen, same stabilizing spot as step 01, naturally connected through bent upper arm. Head naturally aligned with spine and shoulders/hips stacked. No torso rolling, no shoulder-only lift, no back extension, no straight-leg plank.
Full head, complete feet and both hands visible, clear left forearm and left knee contact points, natural anatomy and adult proportions. Exactly one woman, two arms two legs, natural fingers. One photographic frame only, no texts, arrows, numbers, graphics, watermark, collage or panels.
